statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered
Patient has history of atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Patient has personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The service was denied under CO-197
Continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
